tasks.title: Initialize WXT foundation and publish setup branch
tasks.description: Create a cross-browser React/TypeScript WXT skeleton without destroying legacy main/master; install project skills and Task Master, add TDD and Chromium E2E smoke checks, verify builds and Firefox lint, commit and push setup/wxt-foundation.
tasks.testStrategy: npm run check; npm run test:e2e; npm run test:firefox:lint; git status and remote branch verified.

tasks.title: Build browser bookmark projection and synchronization
tasks.description: Model the native bookmark tree as source of truth; add Dexie projection, initial async hydration, onChanged/onMoved/onRemoved reconciliation including deleted descendants, and UI that renders cached data before background wakes.
tasks.testStrategy: Unit tests for projection/reconciliation; fake-indexeddb integration and real-browser checks; startup timing at 10k/50k.

subtasks.title: Domain projection model and reconciliation rules
subtasks.description: Pure functions: flattening getTree() into nodes, tree assembly, partial onChanged merge, onCreated/onMoved application, cascade removal of descendants (onRemoved fires only for the folder), reorder handling. No browser/Dexie imports.

subtasks.title: Dexie projection store adapter
subtasks.description: Dexie v1 schema: nodes keyed by id, meta records for snapshot freshness; readAll/replaceAll/upsert/remove plus meta timestamps. Layout must survive thousands of nodes.

subtasks.title: Background bookmark synchronizer and messaging
subtasks.description: Initial hydration from bookmarks.getTree(), event subscriptions (created/changed/moved/removed/reordered/import) applying domain rules and persisting diffs; broadcast change notifications to open pages; expose read-repair resync.

subtasks.title: Manager explorer renders cached projection first
subtasks.description: Manager page reads the Dexie projection before background wakes, shows loading/sync state, renders an accessible tree (folders expandable, bookmarks open in new tab), refreshes on background broadcasts. Popup keeps compact links.

subtasks.title: Projection performance baseline at 10k and 50k nodes
subtasks.description: Pure normalize/build timing and IndexedDB read timing with generated fixtures; document measured numbers instead of invented thresholds.

tasks.title: Implement accessible bookmark explorer and popup operations
tasks.description: Create side navigation, two panes, tabs, paths, list/table/grid, virtualized large views, keyboard selection, rectangle selection, dnd-kit DnD and essential popup actions; add ru/en and theme settings.
tasks.testStrategy: Test-first component interactions and keyboard accessibility; Chromium/Firefox extension smoke tests, reduced-motion and large tree benchmarks.

subtasks.title: Two-pane explorer shell with folder navigation and breadcrumbs
subtasks.description: Pure path helpers (children of folder, breadcrumb chain, visible top-level folders) plus UI: sidebar folder tree, content pane for the selected folder, breadcrumb navigation, cache-first loading kept.

subtasks.title: Content views: list, table and grid with persisted preference
subtasks.description: Three renderings of the current folder children with a view switcher; preference survives reload with a versioned localStorage key and safe fallback for unknown values.

subtasks.title: Virtualized rendering for large folders
subtasks.description: TanStack Virtual for list/table rows with measured row heights, stable keys and content-visibility fallback; keep accessibility (roving focus) intact.

subtasks.title: Selection model and keyboard navigation
subtasks.description: Click/ctrl/shift selection, select-all, marquee rectangle selection across a pane, arrow/Home/End navigation, aria-selected and focus management.

subtasks.title: Drag and drop move with dnd-kit
subtasks.description: Move bookmarks and folders onto folders or positions with keyboard-accessible alternative (menu action), optimistic UI plus reconcile on browser events and conflict handling.

subtasks.title: Popup essential operations
subtasks.description: Compact popup: current page bookmark action, recent/most-used list, quick search entry, open-manager navigation, accessible labels and focus order.

subtasks.title: Locale ru/en and theme switching
subtasks.description: Minimal i18n layer with ru/en dictionaries for the extension UI, language preference, and light/dark/system theme with custom tokens; no hardcoded strings left in explorer.

subtasks.title: Explorer end-to-end and accessibility verification
subtasks.description: Playwright flow: navigate folders via breadcrumbs, switch views, select multiple, move a bookmark, verify persistence after reload; axe-style checks for the main regions.

subtasks.title: Virtualize grid rows for large folders
subtasks.description: Extend virtualization to the grid view by chunking items into measured rows and rendering only the visible window, keeping card accessibility and stable keys.
subtasks.details: Follow-up to 3.3, which virtualizes list, table and search-result rows. Grid needs a column count derived from the pane width; measure the pane and cap DOM nodes for thousands of cards.

tasks.title: Add rules, metadata, search and undo/redo
tasks.description: Port useful tag/domain concepts from legacy source via isolated use cases; tags/descriptions, domain rules, MiniSearch worker, structured filters, reversible commands and external-conflict detection.
tasks.testStrategy: Vitest contracts; Dexie fake-indexeddb migration and operations; cross-browser integration and 10k/50k search regression.

tasks.title: Add capture features, encrypted private tree and export
tasks.description: Create opt-in content script for scroll/text/image capture, screenshot/archive adapters and least-privilege permissions; encrypted virtual folders separate from native bookmarks; import/export and backup.
tasks.testStrategy: Permission and security tests, encryption round-trip and migration tests, true browser coverage for capture and restore.

tasks.title: Implement local statistics and future sync architecture
tasks.description: Design local-only statistics with analytics-strategy, transparent metric definitions and no telemetry by default; then evaluate Google Drive metadata sync and conflicts separately.
tasks.testStrategy: Tests on fixture event streams, consent/privacy review, cross-browser storage checks and sync conflict tests before enabling remote operations.

tasks.title: Establish Firefox runtime E2E and performance gates
tasks.description: Add isolated Firefox profile with installed add-on via web-ext and browser automation, plus Chromium and Firefox end-to-end CRUD, restart, Dexie and benchmark suites; gate regressions on measured thresholds.
tasks.testStrategy: Run both real browser suites, Firefox web-ext lint, a11y review, 10k/50k datasets, record baselines.

tasks.title: Visual redesign: Explorer-style manager navigation and toolbar
tasks.description: Priority visual/UX work for the bookmark manager. Keep the existing Dexie projection, folder navigation and list/table/grid modes. Build a Windows File Explorer-inspired layout: left quick-links rail with settings anchored at bottom, right bookmark content, breadcrumbs with an editable folder path above the content and adjacent working search. Intuitive, icon-forward design with visible labels and accessible interactions. Do not implement unrelated task-3 features (virtualization, DnD, selection, popup) as part of this work.
tasks.details: New priority P0 after completed 3.1/3.2. Use the user-provided reference image as visual direction, not a pixel-perfect requirement. No native bookmark mutations for pinning shortcuts; store UI shortcut metadata separately. Existing search engine in task 4 remains future scope. All interactions must work with cached projection and react to background updates.
tasks.testStrategy: TDD unit/component tests for quick-link persistence, folder/path navigation and search; Chromium extension E2E for navigation, settings, path entry, search and reload; npm run check; keyboard-only/accessibility/contrast/reduced-motion review; Firefox runtime coverage remains task 7.

subtasks.title: [P0] Define and build Explorer-style visual shell
subtasks.description: Rework manager hierarchy using the attached image as visual direction, not pixel-perfect copy: persistent left navigation rail; right content pane with a top row for breadcrumbs/editable address and adjacent search; bookmarks below. Retain existing folder data, cache-first render and list/table/grid switch. Reserve a fixed bottom slot for Settings in the sidebar. Clear selected/current location; adaptable widths and narrow-window fallback.
subtasks.details: Start by mapping existing BookmarkExplorer, FolderTree, FolderContent and shell.css. Establish icon/spacing/type/color states and a keyboard/focus order before refactoring. Avoid decorative controls that do nothing. Deliver an intuitive icon-first interface with readable labels/tooltips, never icon-only meaning.

subtasks.title: [P0] Add sidebar quick links and anchored Settings
subtasks.description: Sidebar quick links to useful locations (top-level bookmark folders and user-pinned folders/bookmarks); a Settings button remains at the bottom even when links scroll. Folder shortcuts navigate the right pane; bookmark shortcuts open safely; Settings opens the existing options page.
subtasks.details: Keep pinned shortcuts as local UI metadata keyed by native bookmark IDs; do not duplicate or mutate browser bookmarks. Support pin/unpin, stable ordering and persistence across reload; gracefully handle renamed/deleted targets and empty state. Icons must have text/accessible names and visible active/focus states.

subtasks.title: [P0] Add breadcrumb and editable folder address
subtasks.description: Above the right pane, show clickable breadcrumbs that toggle into a path field (Explorer-style). Enter resolves a folder path and opens it; Escape cancels; invalid paths keep the current folder and show inline feedback; returning to breadcrumbs restores the canonical path.
subtasks.details: Treat addresses as bookmark folder paths, never website URLs or OS filesystem paths. Define escaping/disambiguation for duplicate folder names (offer a chooser or explicit ambiguity error; never silently select the wrong folder). Sync path, selection, sidebar and content after navigation, rename, deletion and page reload. Preserve keyboard focus.

subtasks.title: [P0] Put working bookmark search beside address
subtasks.description: Place a labeled search field beside the address/breadcrumb control. Search title and URL across the cached native-bookmark projection with useful result names and folder locations; clear search returns to the current folder. Show empty/loading/error states and keep search and address controls visually distinct.
subtasks.details: Start with simple substring search and measured responsiveness for large fixtures; debounce or defer filtering as needed. No advanced query syntax, tags or worker yet: those remain in task 4. Keyboard: focus shortcut if not conflicting, Enter on result opens or navigates appropriately, Escape clears/returns focus; support screen-reader result count.

subtasks.title: [P1] Visual polish, responsive behavior and icon accessibility
subtasks.description: Polish iconography, hover/selected/focus states, contrast, compact spacing, overflow and adaptable layout at extension-manager window widths. Retain list/table/grid controls, distinguish folders vs links without relying only on color, and avoid excessive motion.
subtasks.details: Prefer one consistent icon set (no emoji as production icons). Verify tooltips/visible labels and accessible names, 44px-ish comfortable hit targets where practical, reduced-motion preference, long names and narrow windows. Review against current web-design-guidelines.

subtasks.title: [P1] Verify redesigned manager in real extension and document UX contract
subtasks.description: Cover sidebar quick links/settings, breadcrumb clicks and path entry (including duplicate/invalid paths), search/clear, reload persistence and all three existing content views with tests. Validate Chromium extension visually and with keyboard-only navigation; leave Firefox runtime to task 7.
subtasks.details: Write failing behavior tests before implementation; use current projection client and fake-indexeddb for storage changes. Run npm run check, npm run test:e2e and Firefox lint. Update root AGENTS.md only if an important architecture constraint is introduced.
